name: api-status
description: Band above the prompt with one value read from an HTTP API you configure; token kept in secure storage; offline state

url.title: Status URL
url.description: https:// URL returning JSON (http:// only for localhost)

field.title: JSON field
field.description: Dotted path to the value to show, e.g. status or data.deploy.state

token.title: API token
token.description: Optional. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. Stored in secure storage, never shown.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: 0 = only on demand (/api-status or r). Minimum 15.
